component.name: Atlas Updater
component.summary: Update AtlasOS, go back to the previous version, and pick a channel

description.p: Atlas Updater shows the AtlasOS version you are running, the update that is waiting for a restart, and the version you can go back to. It reads the release notes of the new version, updates Flatpak apps, and lets you restart now or at a time you choose.
It never collects usage data. If it crashes, it can save a report with system information and resource use, but nothing is sent unless you choose to send it.
